errors.what: `$PY` set in one Bash call was empty in the next (shell state does not persist), so a heredoc edit silently did not run while the test append did
headroom.py imported the 7g run.py as `run`, which collides with milestone 6's `run` that run.py itself imports (AttributeError)
errors.fix: loaded run.py via importlib under the name m7g_run

doc_friction.issue: suggests `PY=$(python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py ...)` then `"$PY"`; in cloud sessions shell variables do not persist between tool calls, so the next call runs `$PY` as empty and heredoc scripts fail with '-: command not found'. Worth one line: use the printed absolute path.

every milestone script is called run.py and imports milestone 6's run.py as `run` via sys.path, so a follow-up script cannot `import run` its sibling; 7d's diag.py gets away with it only because 7d's run.py does not import M6 as `run`.
